text:
anika: Postmortem follow-up from 2026-03-17 incident — p95 latency spikes. Trying to lock owners and timelines for remediation + SLO updates. Short thread to capture action items.

sam: Quick recap: autoscaler flapped on small batches, KV cache evicted across 3 zones, fallback routing caused thundering. Error budget saw a p95 burst for ~12h.

mike: Can we quantify recurrence? I saw the same pattern 3 times in the last 30 days but with slightly different triggers.

alyssa: Agree. Our dashboard doesn't highlight recurrence well. Propose adding a recurrence heatmap and a rolling occurrence count for p95 breaches.

sam: Owner suggestions: - autoscaler tuning: @mike - cache config: @alyssa - routing fallback policy: @anika

anika: I can own the routing fallback policy rollouts. Proposed timeline: 2 weeks for a small config change + canary, 6 weeks for a full autoscaler retune with bench tests.

mike: For autoscaler retune, propose a staged plan: week1 - benchmark; week2 - canary in staging; week3 - small prod canary; week4-6 - full rollout. Will spin up an eval harness for realistic traffic.

devops: I'll add a weekly "remediation tickler" calendar invite for action owners and a Loom runbook. Also will tag the runbook with a recurrence label so it's easy to search.

devops: Suggested alert tweak to catch recurrence instead of single blips:
```
alert: RecurringP95Spike
expr: increase(request_latency_p95[24h]) > 0.15
for: 2h
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "p95 latency rising repeatedly"
```
This should reduce noisy pages but still capture sustained regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by @mike for 3951100000. Notified oncall.

alyssa: Error budget note: we burned ~3% this month from these events. Options: temporary SLO relaxation for a training window (not ideal) or lower non-critical batch priority. I lean toward the latter.

anika: Don't relax SLOs yet. Plan: update dashboard with recurrence widget + set guardrails for canary. If we still burn >2% next month after the retune, we escalate SLA discussion and customer comms.

sam: Actions (assigning owners + ETA):
- autoscaler retune: mike, ETA 2026-04-30
- KV cache TTL/eviction review: alyssa, ETA 2026-04-10
- routing fallback policy: anika, ETA 2026-04-03
- recurrence dashboard & alert: devops, ETA 2026-03-31
- weekly tickler + runbook: devops, ongoing
Please ack.

mike: ack — starting bench plan today.

alyssa: ack — will post TTL change experiment details by EOD Monday.

devops: ack — added calendar + created initial dashboard PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/dashboards/pulls/52

anika: I'll own the postmortem action tracker updates and ping SRE in two weeks for status. I'll post a short status snapshot every Friday to this thread. :spiral_calendar:

sam: :thumbsup: Closing note: if recurrence persists after full rollout we consider hard SLA changes + customer comms. For now, track closely and aim to reduce error budget bleed.
